scope: Live catalog retrieval, bounded chat and filter context, successful-request cooldown removal with original AI limits retained

checks.lint: passed (full repository and subsequent changed files)

credentialScan.scope: Web and SEO source plus final candidate browser JavaScript, compared against configured private credentials without printing values

graphify.warning: Structural map only: external references may be dangling and some relationships collapse; not runtime proof.

limitations: Public catalog and reviewed explanations are searched; this is not a general web crawler or access to unpublished WordPress content.
Keyword and listed-location filters are heuristic and do not verify eligibility, degrees, experience or numeric salary thresholds.
General AI remains limited to one execution at a time and existing daily/monthly caps; these are run limits, not a verified dollar cap.
Only up to two minimized recent exchanges are sent for general answers; no durable or cross-device chat memory.
Datadog can retain general prompts and answers; owner-authorized remote agent settings are unchanged.
